# Amazon

> Amazon is a global e-commerce platform offering Prime membership, retail shopping, grocery delivery through Whole Foods Market, payment solutions, and seller services.

Amazon.com provides customers with membership benefits, shopping conveniences, and integrated services including Prime delivery, financial products, and grocery shopping through Whole Foods Market. The platform serves both consumers and business sellers with various programs and tools.

## Key Topics

- Amazon Prime
- Prime membership
- Whole Foods Market
- Amazon Devices
- Payment options
- Delivery service
- Grocery shopping
- Account management
- Amazon Business Card
- Seller programs
- Affiliate opportunities
- Customer service
- Shop with Points
- Organic products
- Weekly sales

## Membership & Prime

- [Amazon Prime @ Amazon.com](https://www.amazon.com/b?node=15240005011): Amazon Prime membership overview with payment options and account management

## Grocery & Food

- [Whole Foods Market: Shop Groceries & Weekly Sales](https://wfm.amazon.com/): Whole Foods Market grocery shopping with Prime membership, delivery, and organic products
